title: VPN Troubleshooting Guide
content: Step-by-step instructions for resolving VPN connection issues.
solution: Verify that the user has an active internet connection.
Clear cached credentials if authentication fails.

title: Network Firewall Configuration
content: Corporate firewalls must allow VPN and general network traffic.
symptoms: VPN traffic blocked at the firewall
solution: Verify that VPN traffic is permitted on ports 500 and 4500 for IPsec-based connections.
Confirm outbound HTTPS (443) is not blocked.
Check for proxy interference on the affected machine.
Escalate to network team if firewall rules were recently changed.

title: VPN Authentication Problems
content: If VPN authentication fails, verify the following.
symptoms: MFA prompt not completing during VPN login
Repeated authentication failure after password change
solution: Confirm the username and password are correct.
Check MFA configuration and that the authenticator app is in sync.
Clear cached credentials in the VPN client.
Verify the authentication method configured in the VPN client matches the server.

title: Wi-Fi and Internet Connectivity Guide
content: Steps to resolve Wi-Fi or internet connectivity issues.
symptoms: No internet access despite Wi-Fi connection
solution: Confirm the Wi-Fi network name and password are correct.
Toggle Wi-Fi off and on, then reconnect.
Restart the router or switch to a wired Ethernet connection to isolate the issue.
Check for an IP address conflict or DHCP failure by running ipconfig /release and ipconfig /renew.
Verify DNS settings; try a public DNS such as 8.8.8.8 if internal DNS fails.

title: Slow Network Performance
content: Steps to diagnose slow or intermittent network speeds.
symptoms: Slow file transfers or page loads
High latency on shared network segment
solution: Run a speed test to confirm the actual throughput.
Check how many devices are connected to the same network segment.
Test with a wired connection to rule out Wi-Fi interference.
Check for background applications consuming bandwidth.
Escalate to the network team if the issue persists across multiple devices.

title: Password Reset Guide
content: Steps to reset a forgotten or expired password.
symptoms: User locked out after multiple failed attempts
solution: Navigate to the company password self-service portal.
Verify identity using the registered email or MFA device.
Set a new password meeting the complexity requirements (minimum 12 characters, upper/lowercase, number, symbol).
Sign out and sign back in on all devices to refresh cached credentials.

title: Account Lockout Resolution
content: Steps to resolve an account lockout after failed login attempts.
symptoms: User unable to sign in despite correct password
solution: Confirm the account is actually locked (check Active Directory / IAM status).
Wait for the automatic lockout timer to expire, or have an admin manually unlock it.
Reset the password if the lockout was caused by an outdated cached credential.
Advise the user to update saved passwords in browsers and mobile devices after reset.

title: Single Sign-On (SSO) and MFA Issues
content: Steps to resolve SSO or multi-factor authentication failures.
symptoms: MFA enrollment lost after device replacement
solution: Confirm the identity provider (SSO) service is online.
Check that the MFA authenticator app's time is synced correctly.
Resend or regenerate the MFA enrollment if the device was replaced.
Clear browser cache/cookies for the SSO login page and retry.

title: Software Installation and Licensing Guide
content: Steps to resolve software installation or licensing issues.
solution: Confirm the software is approved and available in the internal software catalog.
Check available disk space and administrator rights before installing.
Verify the license key or seat availability in the license management portal.
Reinstall the application if the installer reports a corrupted package.

title: Application Crash or Freeze Troubleshooting
content: Steps to resolve an application that is crashing, freezing, or unresponsive.
solution: Check for pending software updates and apply them.
Reinstall the application if the issue persists after updates.
Check Event Viewer / crash logs for a specific error code to escalate with detail.

title: Browser Issues and Extensions
content: Steps to resolve browser crashes, slowness, or extension conflicts.
solution: Clear the browser cache and cookies.
Disable extensions one by one to isolate a conflicting extension.
Update the browser to the latest version.
Try an alternate supported browser to confirm whether the issue is browser-specific.

title: Laptop and Peripheral Hardware Guide
content: Steps to resolve common laptop and peripheral hardware issues.
solution: Reseat or replace the cable/peripheral (keyboard, mouse, monitor, USB device) to rule out a loose connection.
Test the peripheral on another machine to isolate whether the fault is the device or the port.
Update or reinstall the device driver.
For battery/charging issues, test with a different charger before requesting a replacement.
Log a hardware replacement request if the fault is confirmed physical.

title: Printer Troubleshooting Guide
symptoms: Printer shows offline or low supplies warning
solution: Confirm the printer has power and is connected to the network or via USB.
Clear the print queue and restart the print spooler service.
Check for paper jams, low toner, or ink warnings.
Reinstall the printer driver if print jobs fail silently.

title: Display and Docking Station Issues
content: Steps to resolve monitor, docking station, or external display issues.
solution: Confirm the display cable is fully seated at both ends.
Test the monitor/dock with another laptop to isolate the fault.
Check display settings for correct resolution and detected output.

title: Server and Production System Outage Guide
content: Steps to triage a server, database, or production system outage.
symptoms: Server or database outage affecting users
solution: Confirm the scope of the outage (single service vs entire system).
Check server resource usage: CPU, memory, and disk space.
Review recent deployments or configuration changes that may correlate with the outage.
Restart the affected service if safe to do so, following the incident runbook.
Escalate immediately to the infrastructure/on-call team for production-down incidents.

title: Database Connectivity and Performance
content: Steps to resolve database connectivity or performance issues.
solution: Verify the database service is running and reachable on the expected port.
Check active connection counts against the configured connection pool limit.
Review slow query logs for long-running queries.
Check disk space on the database server; full disks are a common cause of failure.

title: Deployment and Service Failure Guide
content: Steps to resolve a failed deployment or crashed background service.
solution: Check the deployment pipeline logs for the failure point.
Roll back to the last known good release if the failure is deployment-related.
Restart the affected service and monitor for stability.
Check system logs for out-of-memory or resource-exhaustion errors.

title: VPN connection fails
problem: User cannot connect to the corporate VPN.
solution: Restart the computer and try again.
If the issue continues, contact the network support team.

title: VPN disconnects frequently
problem: VPN disconnects repeatedly during remote work.

title: VPN authentication error
problem: VPN authentication fails even though the user believes the password is correct.
solution: Check whether the account is locked.

title: Slow VPN performance
problem: Applications become slow when connected to VPN.
solution: Use the nearest approved VPN gateway.
Contact network support if latency remains high.

title: Cannot access internal application through VPN
problem: User connects successfully to VPN but cannot access an internal application.
solution: Escalate to network support if multiple applications are affected.

title: Wi-Fi cannot connect
problem: Laptop cannot connect to the corporate Wi-Fi.
solution: Forget and reconnect to the corporate network.
Check whether other devices can connect.

title: Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting
problem: Wireless connection repeatedly disconnects.
solution: Move closer to the access point.
Forget and reconnect to the network.
Contact network support if the problem affects multiple users.

title: No internet connection
problem: User has connected to the network but cannot access the internet.
solution: Restart the router or approved network equipment.
Escalate if the outage affects multiple users.

title: DNS resolution failure
problem: User cannot access websites because domain names are not resolving.
solution: Escalate persistent DNS failures to network support.

title: IP address conflict
problem: Two devices are using the same IP address.
solution: Disconnect and reconnect to the network.
Escalate recurring conflicts to network administration.

title: Password reset required
problem: User has forgotten the corporate password.
solution: Open the approved password reset portal.
Sign in again after the reset.

title: Account locked
problem: User account has been locked after repeated failed login attempts.
solution: Wait for automatic unlock if configured.
Use the approved account unlock process.

title: MFA code not received
problem: User does not receive the expected MFA verification code.
solution: Contact identity support if MFA remains unavailable.

title: MFA push notification not appearing
problem: The authentication approval notification does not appear on the registered device.

title: New employee account access
problem: A new employee needs access to corporate systems.

title: Employee cannot access shared folder
problem: User cannot access an authorized shared folder.
solution: Request access through the approved access-management process.

title: Single sign-on failure
problem: User cannot sign in to an application through SSO.
solution: Clear browser cookies for the application.
Check whether other SSO applications work.
Escalate if the issue is application-wide.

title: Expired user password
problem: Corporate password has expired.
solution: Sign in again using the new password.

title: Application permission denied
problem: User can log in but cannot access a required application feature.
solution: Request the required role through the access-management process.

title: Inactive account
problem: Corporate account has been disabled due to inactivity.

title: Laptop does not power on
problem: Laptop does not start when the power button is pressed.
solution: Hold the power button for several seconds.
Escalate for hardware inspection if unsuccessful.

title: Laptop battery drains quickly
problem: Laptop battery does not hold charge for the expected duration.
solution: Replace the battery if health is poor.

title: External monitor not detected
problem: External monitor is not detected by the computer.
solution: Use the operating system display-detection option.

title: Keyboard not working
problem: Keyboard input is not being detected.
solution: Replace the keyboard if hardware failure is confirmed.

title: Mouse not responding
problem: Mouse pointer does not move or respond.

title: Printer not printing
problem: User sends a document to the printer but receives no printed output.
solution: Confirm the correct printer is selected.
Restart the print service or printer.

title: Printer shows offline
problem: Network printer appears offline.
solution: Contact printer support if the issue persists.

title: Laptop overheating
problem: Laptop becomes unusually hot during normal usage.
solution: Move the laptop to a hard surface.
Escalate for hardware inspection if overheating continues.

title: Webcam not working
problem: Camera does not work in a video meeting application.
solution: Close other applications using the camera.

title: Headset microphone not working
problem: Microphone input from a headset is not detected.
solution: Test the microphone in system settings.

title: Application crashes on startup
problem: An enterprise application closes immediately after launch.
solution: Clear the application's temporary data if supported.
Escalate with application logs if the problem continues.

title: Application is running slowly
problem: An enterprise application responds slowly.
solution: Escalate if multiple users experience the same problem.

title: Software installation failure
problem: Approved software fails to install.
solution: Run the approved installer with required permissions.

title: Software update failed
problem: Application update cannot be completed.
solution: Use the approved software deployment process if manual updating fails.

title: Browser pages not loading
problem: Web pages fail to load correctly.
solution: Check whether the website is available to other users.

title: Browser cache causing application issues
problem: A web application behaves incorrectly because of stale browser data.
solution: Clear cache and site data for the affected application.

title: PDF file will not open
problem: User cannot open a PDF document.
solution: Verify the file is completely downloaded.
Request a new copy if the document is corrupted.

title: Office document is read-only
problem: User cannot edit an office document.
solution: Verify whether another user has the document open.
Save a local copy if permitted.

title: Application license expired
problem: An application reports that its license has expired.
solution: Sign out and sign in again.
Use the approved license activation process.
Contact software administration if the license is unavailable.

title: Application cannot connect to server
problem: Enterprise application cannot communicate with its backend server.
solution: Check whether the server is available to other users.
Escalate a widespread outage to application support.

title: Phishing email reported
problem: User receives a suspicious email requesting credentials or payment information.
solution: Do not click links or attachments.
Report the email using the approved security-reporting mechanism.
Delete or quarantine the message after reporting.

title: Malware alert on workstation
problem: Endpoint security software reports possible malware.
solution: Disconnect the device from the network if instructed by security procedures.

title: Suspicious login notification
problem: User receives a notification for a login they do not recognize.
solution: Do not approve unknown MFA requests.

title: Endpoint antivirus disabled
problem: Endpoint security protection appears disabled.
solution: Do not install unauthorized security software.
Restart the endpoint protection service if permitted.
Contact security support if protection remains disabled.

title: USB device security restriction
problem: A USB storage device is blocked by corporate security policy.
solution: Verify whether the device is approved.
Contact security support if business justification exists.

title: Security certificate warning
problem: Browser reports an invalid or expired security certificate.
solution: Do not bypass certificate warnings on unknown sites.
Contact application or security support if the corporate site certificate appears invalid.

title: Unauthorized software detected
problem: Endpoint management detects software that is not approved.
solution: Do not attempt to bypass endpoint controls.
Submit an approved software request if the application is required for business use.

title: Account suspected of compromise
problem: User believes corporate credentials may have been compromised.
solution: Do not approve unexpected MFA requests.

title: Ransomware warning
problem: User observes suspicious file encryption or a ransomware warning.
solution: Disconnect the device from the network immediately if safe to do so.
Do not pay or interact with the attacker.
Contact the security incident-response team immediately.

title: Security policy violation
problem: A workstation or account may have violated corporate security policy.
solution: Stop the activity causing the alert.
Do not attempt to disable security controls.
Notify the security or compliance team.

title: Cloud application unavailable
problem: User cannot access a company cloud application.
solution: Check whether other users are affected.

title: Cloud storage synchronization failure
problem: Files are not synchronizing with corporate cloud storage.
solution: Verify available local and cloud storage.

title: Cloud virtual machine unavailable
problem: An assigned cloud virtual machine cannot be reached.
solution: Restart the VM only through approved procedures.

title: Cloud storage quota exceeded
problem: User cannot upload files because cloud storage capacity has been exceeded.
solution: Empty the recycle bin if appropriate.

title: Cloud authentication failure
problem: User cannot authenticate to a cloud service.

title: Cloud service latency
problem: Cloud application response times are unusually high.
solution: Check whether other cloud services are affected.

title: Cloud backup job failed
problem: Scheduled cloud backup did not complete successfully.
solution: Escalate repeated failures to infrastructure support.

title: Cloud resource access denied
problem: User receives an access-denied error when accessing a cloud resource.
solution: Request appropriate access through the approved process.

title: Cloud deployment failed
problem: An approved cloud deployment fails.
solution: Escalate infrastructure errors to the cloud engineering team.

title: Cloud monitoring alert
problem: Cloud monitoring reports abnormal resource usage.

title: Database connection failure
problem: Application cannot connect to the database.
solution: Escalate database outages to the database team.

title: Database query running slowly
problem: Application database queries take unusually long to complete.
solution: Escalate persistent performance issues to database administrators.

title: Database authentication failure
problem: Application cannot authenticate to the database.
solution: Escalate credential issues to database administration.

title: Database storage full
problem: Database storage has reached its capacity.

title: Database backup failure
problem: Scheduled database backup failed.
solution: Retry the backup through the approved process.

title: Email not sending
problem: User cannot send email messages.
solution: Check the outbox for stuck messages.

title: Email not receiving
problem: User is not receiving expected emails.
solution: Ask the sender to confirm delivery if necessary.

title: Mailbox full
problem: User's mailbox has reached its storage limit.
solution: Archive old messages according to policy.
Request additional mailbox storage if required.

title: Email attachment blocked
problem: Email attachment is blocked by security controls.
solution: Verify whether the attachment type is allowed.
Do not rename files to bypass security controls.
Use an approved secure file-sharing service.
Contact security support if the attachment is business-critical.

title: Email application keeps asking for password
problem: Email client repeatedly requests authentication.
solution: Sign out and sign in again.
Clear saved credentials only through approved procedures.

title: Calendar meeting invitation missing
problem: User does not see an expected meeting invitation.
solution: Search the mailbox for the meeting subject.
Ask the organizer to resend the invitation.
Check whether calendar synchronization is working.

title: Video meeting audio unavailable
problem: User cannot hear other participants in an online meeting.
solution: Verify the meeting application's audio settings.

title: Video meeting camera unavailable
problem: User cannot enable the camera during an online meeting.

title: Email messages going to spam
problem: Legitimate emails are being delivered to the spam folder.
solution: Check the spam or junk folder.
Mark legitimate messages as not spam.
Add approved senders to the safe-sender list if permitted.
Report recurring filtering problems to email support.

title: Shared mailbox access problem
problem: User cannot open an authorized shared mailbox.
solution: Confirm the shared mailbox still exists.
Request access through the approved process.

title: Windows update failed
problem: Operating system updates fail to install.
solution: Contact endpoint support if updates continue to fail.

title: Computer running slowly
problem: Computer performance is significantly slower than normal.

title: Disk space running low
problem: System drive has very little free space.
solution: Move approved large files to corporate storage.
Escalate if more storage is required.

title: Windows login takes too long
problem: Computer takes an unusually long time to complete login.

title: Blue screen error
problem: Windows displays a blue screen and restarts.
solution: Escalate repeated blue-screen failures to endpoint support.

title: Remote desktop connection failed
problem: User cannot connect to a corporate remote desktop environment.
solution: Connect to the corporate VPN if required.
Escalate if the remote service is unavailable.

title: Network drive unavailable
problem: Mapped network drive cannot be accessed.

title: Internal website unavailable
problem: Corporate internal website cannot be opened.
solution: Escalate if multiple users are affected.

title: Network latency is high
problem: Applications experience unusually high network latency.
solution: Check whether the problem affects multiple applications.

title: Network printer access denied
problem: User cannot access a network printer because of permissions.

title: Password manager access problem
problem: User cannot access the corporate password manager.
solution: Clear relevant browser data if approved.
Contact identity support if access remains unavailable.

title: User cannot change password
problem: User attempts to change the corporate password but receives an error.
solution: Contact identity support if the error persists.

title: MFA device replacement
problem: User has a new phone and needs to reconfigure MFA.
solution: Use the approved MFA re-registration process.
Contact identity support if the old device is required for verification.

title: Temporary access request
problem: User requires temporary access to a restricted corporate resource.
solution: Obtain required manager or resource-owner approval.
Access should expire according to policy.

title: User account synchronization issue
problem: Changes to a user's account are not reflected across corporate applications.
solution: Escalate synchronization failures to identity administration.

title: Corporate application outage
problem: Multiple users cannot access a business-critical application.
solution: Confirm the scope of the outage.
Create or update the incident record.
Escalate to the application support team.

title: Application data not updating
problem: Business application displays old or stale information.
solution: Sign out and sign in again.
Check whether other users see the same issue.

title: Application report generation failed
problem: Business application cannot generate a required report.
solution: Reduce the report date range if appropriate.

title: Application integration failure
problem: Data is not being transferred between two enterprise applications.
solution: Escalate to the integration support team.

title: User receives application timeout
problem: Business application repeatedly times out.
solution: Check whether other users are affected.

title: File accidentally deleted
problem: User accidentally deleted an important corporate file.
solution: Check the recycle bin if applicable.
Do not overwrite the affected storage unnecessarily.
Contact IT support for backup recovery if required.

title: Employee workstation replacement
problem: Employee requires a replacement workstation because of hardware failure.

title: IT service request status
problem: User wants to check the status of an existing IT service request.
solution: Review the current assignment and status.
Contact the assigned support group if additional information is required.

title: Employee onboarding IT checklist
problem: New employee requires standard IT setup.
solution: Verify VPN, email, and collaboration access.

title: Employee offboarding IT checklist
problem: Employee departure requires corporate IT access to be removed.
solution: Disable the corporate account according to the approved schedule.
Confirm completion of the offboarding checklist.
